issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks Farm.addAnimal(Animal) as private (shown with a '-') while the exercise usage and the solution expect it to be public: the provided Main (template) calls farm.addAnimal(...), and the solution implements addAnimal as a public method. This visibility mismatch between the UML and the intended API can confuse students about whether addAnimal should be implemented as public or private and prevents them from following the example usage in Main.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility consistent: update the UML in the problem statement to mark addAnimal(Animal) as public (change '-' to '+') and explicitly state in the text that addAnimal is part of the public API. Ensure the template includes a public addAnimal(Animal) method stub so students can implement it consistent with the example Main and the solution.
